headline: Satin Creditcare subsidiary SGAL invests ₹5 crore in Indic Wisdom
summary: Satin Growth Alternatives Limited, a subsidiary of Satin Creditcare Network Limited, has made its first investment of ₹5 crore in Indic Wisdom. The capital, structured as NCDs and CCPS, will fund manufacturing scale-up and distribution expansion.

headline: Kec International wins Rs 1303 crore order from multiple clients
summary: Confirmed work order for T&D and cables across India, Middle East, and Americas. Adds to backlog covering 1.76 quarters of revenue. Order inflow stable after Q1FY27 surge.

headline: Info Edge appoints Himanshu Agarwal as CFO
summary: Info Edge (India) Ltd appoints Himanshu Agarwal as CFO and Additional Director, replacing interim CFO Ambarish Raghuvanshi. Naresh Chand Gupta joins as Independent Director.

headline: Poojaa Precision hosts investor meet on Sep 17
summary: Poojaa Precision Engg. Ltd will host an investor meeting on September 17, 2026, in Pune, Chakan, and Mumbai. The session is open to investors via in-person or virtual modes.

headline: Supra Pacific Financial to issue ₹50 crore NCDs
summary: Supra Pacific Financial Services Ltd schedules board meeting on September 17, 2026, to approve issuance of secured, unrated NCDs worth ₹50 crore via private placement.

headline: JK Bank AGM addendum: Tharchin joins board
summary: Jammu and Kashmir Bank issued an addendum for its 88th AGM on September 22, 2026. The notice adds the appointment of Tsewang Tharchin as a director and notes the retirement of R. K. Chhibber.

headline: Paisalo Digital to host investor meet in Dubai
summary: Paisalo Digital Limited will conduct a non-deal roadshow in Dubai from September 17 to 19, 2026. The event includes physical group and one-on-one meetings with institutional investors.

headline: Om Galaxy IPO Day 3: Subscription hits 1.02x
summary: Om Galaxy IPO is subscribed 1.02x on Day 3. QIBs lead with 3.11x demand. Issue closes on 15-09-2026. Check category-wise breakdown and offer details.

headline: Coforge Announces TechCon 2026 Global AI Event
summary: Coforge Limited announced TechCon 2026, its flagship global technology event focusing on enterprise AI adoption and workforce readiness. The event will feature a company-wide hackathon with over 3,000 participants.

headline: Manika Plastech IPO Day 2: Retail leads demand
summary: Manika Plastech IPO is subscribed 1.31x on Day 2. Retail investors lead with 2.08x subscription, while QIB remains at 0x. Check full category-wise breakdown and offer details.

headline: Raksan Transformers IPO Day 3: Subscription Stagnant at 1.38x
summary: Raksan Transformers IPO subscription remains flat at 1.38x on Day 3. QIB leads with 3.87x demand, while Retail and NII categories show modest interest. Issue closes on September 15, 2026.

headline: Maharaja and Speedex IPO Day 3: Subscription Stalls
summary: Maharaja and Speedex IPO subscription remains at 0.52x on Day 3. QIB demand is zero, while NII (sHNI) leads with 1.34x. Issue closes on September 15, 2026.

headline: Injecto Polymers IPO Day 2: Subscription Stagnant at 0.29x
summary: Injecto Polymers IPO sees no growth on Day 2, remaining at 0.29x. QIB leads with 1.02x while Retail and NII lag. Issue closes on September 16, 2026.

headline: Panchatv Bharat IPO Day 3: Subscription Stagnant at 0.09x
summary: Panchatv Bharat IPO sees no fresh bids on Day 3. Total subscription remains flat at 0.09x with zero QIB interest. Issue closes on September 15, 2026.

headline: Veegaland Developers IPO Day 3 Subscription Update
summary: Veegaland Developers IPO is subscribed 1.14x on Day 3. Retail leads at 1.62x, while QIB demand remains flat at 0.45x. Check full subscription status and offer details.

headline: Century Business Media IPO Day 2: Subscription Stagnant
summary: Century Business Media IPO subscription remains at 1.14x on Day 2. QIB leads with 3.51x. Issue closes on 16-09-2026.

headline: Praruh Technologies signs partnership with Quantum Networks
summary: Praruh Technologies Ltd has entered into a partnership agreement with Quantum Networks, an Indian networking technology brand of Zen Exim. The deal involves providing intelligent, secure, and scalable networking solutions for enterprises.

headline: Hyundai Motor India unveils BAYON SUV name
summary: Hyundai Motor India Limited has officially announced the name of its upcoming intelligent SUV, the Hyundai BAYON. The reveal marks a new chapter for the automaker in India, with further details expected soon.

headline: India August WPI Inflation Hits 9.92%
summary: India's wholesale price inflation rose to 9.92% in August, beating the 9.90% estimate. Output PPI also accelerated to 9.81% from 9.57% previously.

headline: Mehul Telecom opens two new retail stores in Ahmedabad
summary: Mehul Telecom Limited announced the opening of two new own retail stores in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, on September 14, 2026. The expansion includes locations in Mani Nagar and Isanpur under the Mehul Telecom brand.

headline: Solar Industries to acquire Omnia Holdings for ₹12,951 crore
summary: Solar Industries India Ltd announced a proposed all-cash acquisition of South Africa's Omnia Holdings for ₹12,951 crore. The deal aims to expand Solar's global footprint in explosives and mining solutions across Africa and international markets.

headline: Baron Infotech AGM extended to Dec 2026
summary: The Registrar of Companies has granted Baron Infotech a three-month extension for its FY26 AGM, pushing the deadline to December 29, 2026, as the firm remains under CIRP.

headline: Steelco Gujarat AGM record date set
summary: Steelco Gujarat Ltd has fixed September 18, 2026 as the cut-off date for its 36th Annual General Meeting. The register of members will remain closed from September 19 to 25, 2026.

headline: GRSE sets Sept 18 record date for final dividend
summary: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Ltd has fixed September 18, 2026 as the record date for its final dividend for FY26, payable within 30 days of AGM approval.

headline: JHS Retail dispatches FY26 annual report, AGM notice
summary: JHS Svendgaard Retail Ventures Limited has dispatched the 19th AGM notice and FY26 Annual Report via web-link and QR code. The virtual meeting is scheduled for September 29, 2026.

headline: Adani Power schedules investor interactions in Sept 2026
summary: Adani Power Limited has announced a schedule of investor and analyst interactions for September 2026, including events in Gurgaon, Hong Kong, and Ahmedabad.

headline: String Metaverse to consider preferential issue
summary: String Metaverse Limited has scheduled a board meeting for September 17, 2026, to consider raising funds through a preferential issue. The trading window will remain closed for designated persons during this period.

headline: BFL Asset Finvest appoints Mudit Singhi as independent director
summary: BFL Asset Finvest Ltd approved the appointment of Mudit Singhi as a Non-Executive Independent Director for five years, effective August 7, 2026. The move was ratified at the 31st AGM.

headline: Quint Digital board approves related party transactions
summary: Quint Digital Limited's board meeting on September 14, 2026, approved related party loans and asset pledges. Shareholder approval via postal ballot is required for these matters.

headline: Times Green Energy AGM: ₹30 crore NCDs approved
summary: Times Green Energy India Ltd held its 16th AGM on September 14, 2026. Shareholders approved a ₹30 crore NCD issue, auditor appointment, and director regularizations. The meeting concluded with no adverse remarks.

headline: Patels Airtemp AGM: Dividend, Orders
summary: Patels Airtemp (India) Ltd held its 34th AGM on September 14, 2026. Shareholders approved a ₹3 dividend per share and noted new order inflows of ₹225 crore from Dangote Refineries.

headline: Onemi Technology to raise funds via preferential issue
summary: Onemi Technology Solutions Ltd schedules board meeting on Sep 17, 2026, to consider raising funds through a preferential issue. Trading window closed for designated persons.

headline: Commercial Syn Bags to convert warrants into equity
summary: Commercial Syn Bags Ltd schedules board meeting on September 17, 2026, to approve conversion of warrants issued to promoters into equity shares upon deposit of balance amount.
